liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I Want To Tell You** (2 reviews): Listener says this was the first I Want To Tell You played in this stretch; Attendee found I Want To Tell You stellar [5][9]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Attendee welcomed Stagger Lee and had predicted it and Black Throated Wind beforehand [9]
- **Foolish Heart** (1 other source): Foolish Heart leads into I Want To Tell You, per the notes [1]
- **The Last Time** (1 review): Listener disliked The Last Time, though treasured hearing Jerry play it [12]
- **Attics Of My Life** (1 review): Listener found Attics of My Life a great version [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **I Want To Tell You**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 7 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **gd94-07-01.sbd.ladner.9369.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 150 min; rated 2.2/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: Top-quality soundboard with some Shoreline ambience, most audible during drums; Jerry, Bobby and Vince are each mixed cleanly but sound distant, like an airplane hangar; Bobby has too much reverb [6][7]
- **gd1994-07-01.116005.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 141 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Sounds somewhat overrecorded in the loud passages [14]

## Around the show

- Sunny summer day by the bay; the listener spent hours in Shoreline parking lots before each of three shows that weekend [3]
- Listener says 1994 was the last year the center parking lot outside the venue was open [3]
- Attendee found it a strange show; the band looked loaded and versions were weak, and the lights came up very fast afterward [9]
- Listener says hometown Shoreline shows tend to get loose, with everyone partying [10]
- Taper's section was in the second tier; Shoreline sounded poor except up close [14]
- Calls this Foolish Heart poor, yet judges the Deer Creek 7/21/94 version worse [5]
- Notes the second night of the 1992 Memorial Day run at Shoreline also had no encore [8]
- Follows four nights off after what the listener calls the year's best show, Vegas third night [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-07-01.sbd.ladner.9369.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>CDR [1]
- **gd1994-07-01.116005.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: source: 2 Neumann KMF4's > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [2]. Also: Recording is a Neumann KMF4 taper source, with few sources of this show circulating [14]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-07-02 Shoreline Amphitheatre, Mountain View, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-07-02-shoreline-amphitheatre-mountain-view-ca-usa/) [16]
- Poster by D.King Gallery: [Grateful Dead July 1994 Shoreline Crew Pass Laminate](https://www.dking-gallery.com/store/Dead_Lam_Shore0701.html) [17]
